method.alignment: Constrained dynamic time warping with an 800 ms band around the duration-adjusted diagonal and a 0.08 penalty for each nondiagonal step. Average the path cost on the submitted clock. Neither source transcript nor truth enters matching.
method.current: Measure the current earlier-copy app route with optional timing and speech enabled. Check every localized or exact difference range on the submitted clock, including gain-adjusted ranges.
method.features: Hann 40 ms spectra every 20 ms; 28 triangular Mel bands from 200 to 6800 Hz. Keep cepstral coefficients 1 to 12 and remove the per-file median. Add symmetric four-hop differences. Relative activity rejects very quiet frames.
method.point: Freeze the largest eligible ordinary AMI control score before evaluating either edit bank. Report every row including unassessed, misplaced and correctly located. A useful range covers at least half the labeled edit and reaches 0.30 temporal IoU.
method.processing_guard: A separate follow-up arm after the first results. Explain the whole pair with one gain or finite impulse response and at most 2% uniform resampling. Fit on alternating 40 ms blocks and require a 95th-percentile relative RMS residual at most 0.10 on each held fold; preserve the original alignment point and report the unguarded arm alongside it. Infer the simplest ratio with denominator at most 256 that produces the submitted sample count under upward rounding. Test the follow-up on two AMI meetings outside point selection, using a different rate.
method.scope: This is a reference-based difference comparison with no new model or AI attribution. The SINE and PartialEdit sources were used previously with different checks. SINE uses one reader and PartialEdit uses three. Two AMI meetings supply selection controls and two separate meetings supply assessment controls.
method.witness: Require a path median cost at most 0.7 and two matching flanks, each 400 ms, with at least 30% of frames above the relative activity floor in both copies. Search 120 ms to 2.4 s spans every 20 ms. The score is interior mean cost minus the larger flank mean. Rank one positive span, preferring the earlier one on ties.
